sponsor: A survey from the Jeremy Amason campaign.
demoNotice: Preview only. Results use fictional sample data; responses are not saved or sent.
question: Choose three issues that matter most to you or affect your day-to-day life in Baltimore and across Maryland.
selectionLimitHint: Uncheck one to change your choices.
selectionHint: Select exactly three issues to submit your response.
thankYouTitle: Thank you for sharing your priorities.
thankYouMessage: Placeholder: A short message about next steps will appear here.
chartNote: Each bar shows the percentage of respondents who selected that issue. Each respondent chooses three issues, so percentages total approximately 300% after rounding. These sample results are not a representative poll.

options.title: Cost of Living
options.description: We all know that the price for everything has increased. I will work to ensure that we are lowering the tax burden and eliminating junk fees (e.g. car registration, gas appliance tax) that cost our families thousands of dollars a year.

options.title: Housing
options.description: Making Maryland a place where people want to live. I will work to create legislation that gives young, first-time home buyers property tax exemption in Baltimore City for 3 years.

options.title: Utility Prices
options.description: My opponents have sat ideally by and have taken campaign donations from BGE. I will work to ensure that utility prices are untaxed, and hold BGE accountable for increasing prices. I will also work to create more nuclear power generation in our state.

options.title: Crime
options.description: While there have been some promising signs, is still prevalent and invasive across our City. I will work to ensure that we enforce all crimes, small to large, and let criminals know that Baltimore is not going to tolerate criminals.

options.title: Taxes and State Budget
options.description: Our leaders have taxed and spent Maryland to death. I will work for a balanced budget, and work to slash wasteful spending, bloated government, and lower income taxes by 20% by 2030 to help the middle class live the American dream.

options.title: Education
options.description: I will work to ensure that our teachers are being compensated, we have enough social workers in our schools, and that our city schools administration can’t continue to line their pockets and waste hundreds of millions of dollars.

options.title: Local Infrastructure
options.description: Work to fix our existing infrastructure, repairing the Hanover Street Bridge immediately, improving our bus services, building bus stop shelters, and financing the Key Bridge.

options.title: Maryland Campaign Finance Reform
options.description: My opponents have taken hundreds of thousands of dollars from corporate and mega-donors. I will work to create legislation that eliminates non-individual donations.

options.title: Maryland Democracy Reforms
options.description: Work for reforms in our electoral system, including term limits for Maryland House and Senate, open primaries so everyone has a voice, and ranked-choice voting that makes our elections more representative.

options.title: Maryland Congressional Gerrymandering
options.description: Fight the Democrat Party that are trying to rig the maps for their benefit, not the benefit of Marylanders or democracy.
